integrity: An analytical proof is supplied, accompanied by numerical checks that do not certify the infinite family. Prior work on quantum-walk dark subspaces and dissipative quantum transport is credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple two-cycle vertex wedge, equal real hopping and a single positive-rate irreversible junction sink. Only infinite-time survival and dark dimension; not finite-time mixing, other graph Hamiltonians, flux, dephasing, or general metric quantum graphs. Publication priority remains subject to external assessment.
title: Two-adic perfect capture and exact dark-state weights on a quantum figure-eight
